_comment: Quest levels and requirements (restart the server after editing). minLevel: the level a quest opens at (below it the NPC shows a grey '!'); level: the quest's level for its reward XP (defaults to minLevel). requiresAnyItem: item ids, one of which the character must own (backpack, equipped or bank) to be offered the quest at all. The Warden armour (Brixos, Rhallai, Vinda, Eanan and Griga in Stonevale) needs a Warden weapon: Sword of the Shining Sun 17338, Bow of the Four Winds 17339, Dagger of the Darkest Night 17340, Wand of the Silver Moon 17341, Totem of the Midnight Stars 17342, or the Meteoric weapon it becomes (17587-17591). Gloves at 85 up to the chest at 100; Roarke's Meteoric Might (the Meteoric weapon) at 105. Warden armour from the disc quests: gloves 60, boots 65, helm 70, legs 75, chest and the weapon 80. Frozen (the Tir na nOg champions' Crest quests, which freeze the Meteoric pieces): gloves 110 (Kyna), boots 115 (Davin), helm 120 (Rhyanne), legs 125 (Carraden), chest 130 (Elidyr), weapon 135 (Niamh). xp: the quest's XP, the same at any level (Segorax's gladiator dailies: Strog 20,000, Balmon 60,000, Crammok 120,000, Ragnor 350,000, Killain 700,000). xpPercentOfLevel instead gives that percent of the XP the player needs for their current level. Either replaces the quest's own XP. Daily quests (Segorax's spars and the other DayRepeat quests) can each be done once a day; finishing one doesn't stop the others. alwaysComplete: true makes every character count as having done the quest (it's never offered), opening whatever it gates: Vaultkeeper Renauld's legacy lux shop.
